entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your order number, please?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloPro cycling shoes, delivered 18 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't fit. I installed my cleats, went for one ride, and they gave me blisters on my heels. They're useless to me.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Comfort is key with any cycling shoes.
Whatever. I just want my money back.
Of course. Let me just double-check our policy here... Yes, absolutely. You are well within the 90-day return window. I can process this return for a full refund for you right now.

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes. Just package the shoes back in their original box, attach the label, and drop them off. Once we receive them at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Right. I'll wait for the email then.
Great. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit. I hope we can help you find a better-fitting pair of shoes in the future. Have a good day.
